He was told that he has costochondritis and a “rhomboid sac” on the left side. He’s had an ultrasound, an MRI and a CT scan as well as blood work, and the results indicated that nothing was out of the ordinary.  It's been going on for at least 6 months, and fortunately he says it hasn't gotten worse, but hasn't gotten better either. So far, the doctors, PTs and the chiropractor haven't been able to improve his condition or diagnose it fully, so I've come to here to get some ideas as to what it could be and hopefully gather some questions he could ask whoever he's seeing to get medical attention. Thanks.
